```sql
-- Sync trigger: DELETE
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS frames_ad AFTER DELETE ON frames BEGIN
  INSERT INTO frames_fts(frames_fts, rowid, name, digest_text, inputs, outputs)
  VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.name, old.digest_text, old.inputs, old.outputs);
END;
```

**How it works:** FTS5 external content tables require a special `INSERT ... VALUES ('delete', ...)` command to remove a row from the index. The UPDATE trigger already demonstrates this pattern — it issues a `'delete'` for the old row before inserting the new one. The DELETE trigger just does the `'delete'` step without re-inserting.
